shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone slab
bird-headed or beaked creature in profile
repeated row of similar motifs along the top
justification: Both are flat slabs carved in low relief with a horizontal band across the top above a figural field, and both include a beaked/bird-headed creature seen in profile, which is the most specific shared trait. But A shows an anthropomorphic winged figure standing beside an elaborate, symmetrically rendered sacred plant with rosettes, rendered with detailed naturalistic musculature, feathering and drapery, whereas B shows a stack of schematic animals (quadrupeds, a bird, snake-like forms) and abstract loops with no human figure, no wings and no floral motif, in a far flatter, more outline-only manner.
